blind_target.title: Coherence of the irrelevant-sound effect: Individual profiles of short-term memory and susceptibility to task irrelevant materials
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly compare this published finding with their own new-sample result.

luna_triage.reason: The Results directly state that the current sample reproduced Elliott and Cowan's significant association between irrelevant-sound-effect difference scores and digit span. The reference list identifies the cited 2005 article; the only supplied shipped original is Macken et al. (2009), a distinct paper, so it does not represent Elliott and Cowan (2005).
luna_triage.omission_quote: Also, as noted in prior work by Elliott and Cowan (2005), there was a significant correlation between the ISE difference score and digit span.
luna_triage.identity_quote: Elliott EM, Cowan N. Coherence of the irrelevant-sound effect: Individual profiles of short-term memory and susceptibility to task irrelevant materials. Memory & Cognition. 2005;33:664–675. doi: 10.3758/BF03195333.
